text: The Voskresen manuscript was written in Old Church Slavonic, archivists at the Novary Text Vault confirmed Tuesday after a six-week ink and parchment review. The 11th-century codex, long mislabeled in catalogues as a regional dialect text, was reclassified following multispectral scans and a letter-by-letter comparison with three benchmark liturgical fragments. Curator Elian Vetro said the team found “consistent grammatical forms, liturgical phrasing, and scribal conventions” matching Old Church Slavonic. The vault estimates the revision will affect 214 indexed records and lift cross-border demand for Slavic paleography services by 8% this quarter. For the sector, the ruling sharpens provenance standards and may accelerate reappraisals of similar holdings.
